leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply the useRef hook to create a mutable reference object in a React component.
Define TypeScript generics with useRef to specify the type of the referenced DOM element.
Utilize the .current property to access and modify the stored value of a useRef object.
Implement useRef with HTMLInputElement type to reference form input elements.
Assign initial values to useRef objects using the null value for DOM element references.
Control component behavior by accessing DOM element properties through typed useRef references.
Execute conditional checks on .current property to safely handle null references before DOM manipulation.
Construct event handlers that utilize typed useRef objects to interact with DOM elements.
Modify DOM element properties directly through typed useRef references for imperative operations.
Use TypeScript type assertions when necessary to refine types for specific useRef scenarios.
Compare mutable useRef values with component state to understand their different update behaviors.
Implement cleanup patterns with useRef to prevent memory leaks in component lifecycle.
